status_note: APPROVED by the owner on 2026-10-17 exactly as proposed. The trigger wording and accepted units may be consumed by issue #57.
canonical_template: Bioaccumulator recipe: <candidate plant> for my <crop>, <area> m2
canonical_example: Bioaccumulator recipe: Stinging Nettle for my Tomato, 25 m2

notes: The prefix is the only trigger. A message without the prefix must not call the tool.
The three arguments are carried entirely by the template; malformed prompts are user error.
The crop is parsed up to the first comma, so crop names must not contain a comma.
The candidate plant may contain spaces and punctuation; it is resolved by the catalog resolver.
The canonical unit is m2; accepted aliases are normalized to m2 before the tool call.

candidate_plant.description: Catalog common or scientific name, or a recipe-named plant string such as 'Nettle leaf'. The oracle resolves it with the same rules as bioaccumulator_oracle.py.

unit.description: Canonical unit m2. The form/parser normalizes the accepted aliases before the call.

rejection_behavior.message: Unit must be m2 in v2. Convert hectares or square feet to m2 before using the trigger.
rejection_behavior.rationale: One form and one canonical unit keep the call arguments and the benchmark scoring unambiguous.

owner_signoff.decision: Approved as proposed: 'Bioaccumulator recipe: <candidate plant> for my <crop>, <area> m2', aliases m2/m²/sq m/square metres/square meters; ha, hectare, ft2, sq ft and acres are rejected with unsupported_unit.

alternatives_considered: Adding an optional method or dilution argument: rejected for v2 because the tool already selects the recipe and reports all recipe dilutions.
Accepting hectares: rejected for v2 to avoid a silent unit conversion in the model's arguments.
A shorter prefix without 'Bioaccumulator recipe:': rejected because it is easier to confuse with ordinary chat.
